grouping_control_same_shape.provenance: Exact A-side control from the Stage05 call-vs-grouping paired differential; preserves the same two-function shape as the call reproducer while replacing postfix call syntax with ordinary grouping.

internal_one_arg_call.provenance: Exact B-side minimal fixture from the live Stage05 paired diagnosis that reproduces parse_ok falling to false during call parsing.

zero_arg_call.provenance: S3 function-call syntax; zero-argument specialization of existing internal call model

array_index_store.source:
fn main() -> i64:
    mut values: i64[3] = [10, 20, 30]
    values[1] = 5
    return values[1]

array_index_load.source:
fn main() -> i64:
    values: i64[3] = [10, 20, 30]
    index: i64 = 1
    return values[index]

unresolved_callee_fail_closed.purpose: Prove unresolved internal callee does not create a fabricated C/A/R record.

constant_array_oob_fail_closed.purpose: Prove constant out-of-range index is rejected according to language semantics.
constant_array_oob_fail_closed.source_shape: fixed array length 3 indexed by constant 3

activation_rule: Stage05 is active. The exact A/B call-vs-grouping inputs are hash-pinned for regression tracking but must still be executed through the authoritative S3 reference compiler before promotion into the official stage map. The grouping control does not claim S3 call completeness; it exists to isolate generic parenthesis behavior from postfix call behavior.
